D.B. Cooper Hijacking is memorable because it does more than present a strange or famous claim. It gives the reader a scene, a pressure, and a reason to keep asking what the story means. D.B. Cooper is the unidentified man who hijacked Northwest Orient Flight 305 on November 24, 1971, received $200,000 and parachutes, then jumped from the aircraft over the Pacific Northwest. The FBI investigated for decades but closed the case in 2016 without identifying him.
